title: Creamy Yellow Seafood Rice Casserole
description: A Brazilian-inspired dish featuring seafood, rice, and a creamy yellow sauce. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the yellow rice according to package instructions.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion; cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the mixed seafood; cook until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the cheesy sauce until heated through.
In a separate saucepan, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Add the cooked yellow rice; stir to combine with the cheesy seafood mixture.
Transfer the rice mixture to a baking dish.
Top with additional grated cheese (if desired).
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
